title: UserItemCreator.CreateSphereSphereContact switched by a data coordinate, with the restitution model
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.55.8 (#3188): the contact switched by the gap of the data coordinates in the post-Newton step as the built-in contact, so that the implicit solver converges with the step size; impactModel 2 (restitution coefficient) with the impact velocity in the data, the recommended model in the examples, not the default. Decided: the switching instant is not located within the step.
releaseNotes: UserItemCreator.CreateSphereSphereContact switches by a data node in its recorded post-Newton step, as the built-in contact, and has the impact models 1 and 2 with the restitution coefficient: equal to mbs.CreateSphereSphereContact to 1e-13, also with damping and the implicit solver, whose solution converges with the step size.
